What was generalizable and now captured:

The CAGR + annual decay factor + arc-elasticity TRIPLE pattern — a recurring composite-metric question shape distinct from the existing single arc-elasticity reference. Key reusable facts recorded:

1. n = end_FY − start_FY (the SPAN, =8 for FY2011→FY2019), NOT the inclusive count (9). This is the easy-to-miss exponent base that would throw all three values off.
2. Decay/growth factor = (Ve/Vs)^(1/n) = 1 + CAGR; lands below 1 for a shrinking series.
3. Arc elasticity = (Ve−Vs)/(Ve+Vs) ÷ (time midpoint %Δ), which resolved to exactly 0.5 here → arc = 2 × midpoint %Δ of value. Verified against gold (-1.162).
4. "Include both budgetary and trust-fund flows" → use the consolidated grand-total outlays line, not a budgetary-only subtotal.
5. Cross-check: arc elasticity and CAGR must share the same sign.

No memory update needed — the delimiter and rounding rules already in memory covered this (MODE A, both spaced and unspaced scored correct here). The procedural formula belongs in the skill, not memory.
